scope: Two source-only semi-supervised physical contrast objectives with seeds 2026092701/02/03, m1-natural single source RX and full three-view PAMF/reference response. Main split excluded. Existing target test results are exposed; development evaluation only.
hypothesis: A same-packet raw/As positive does not require treating two different same-pseudo-label packets as verified same-device samples. Adding different-pseudo-class accepted source packets as negatives may retain discriminative fused identity while learning robustness to a branch-certified simulated channel. Pseudo-label errors can still create false negatives, and the channel simulator may alter useful device information; both are testable limitations, not proven physical invariants.

candidates.mechanism: For each physically routed accepted source-U slot, contrast its current physical-view joint160 with its own detached raw-view joint160 as the only positive. Other accepted raw source-U packets with a different predicted pseudo class are negatives; same predicted class packets are excluded. Require at least one negative, use the existing contrast temperature 0.2, and average over all U slots.
Apply the identical same-packet contrast together with the prior detached same-packet raw/As fusion cosine consistency.

shared: Reuse the four existing ordinary/mixed U student passes and prior branch-certified source As selection; no extra student forwards, no new classifier, no U truth, and no target training. Each paired index starts from the same packet, but existing Tri MixStyle may also mix detached statistics from a same-pseudo-class, different-day partner using the shared six-pass plan; raw-view fusion is therefore not an unmixed signal representation. Both new terms inherit the existing Tri joint contrast coefficient, U loss weight and CE normalizer. Raw teacher features are detached; raw pseudo-CE/KL acceptance and cross-day relations are unchanged, and all gradients flow through the existing branch-specific U/L guard. Negatives are pseudo-class hypotheses, not true-label claims.
initialization: Exact same-setting and same-seed original source-only Tri E20, then own E10+E20 to fixed E50/11100, same source roles and fixed permutation.
evaluation: All six candidate predictions frozen before independent truth-last scoring. Clean and six practical scenes, DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; cross_date separate from cross_rx/cross_both. Report each seed, scenario, TX/RX/day and paired corrections/regressions; no leo_weak, target-driven checkpoint selection or selective reruns.
success: Aim to exceed PL by more than 2 percentage points in clean and all six practical DURA-LU scenes and exceed Tri. All seeds, negative scenes and development-setting limits must be reported.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --packet-contrast --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: N607 ordinary account, immutable release, GPU 0–7 with up to four observed/pending processes per GPU including other owners, memory-reserved, no interruption of healthy jobs.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch and preserves active healthy workers and artifacts. Six real E20 no-query smoke checks must show actual selected same-packet positives, eligible negatives, and signature/reference gradients.
expected_artifacts: Six true-checkpoint no-query source smoke checks
Six own E30/E50 sources and packet-contrast counters
Six frozen seven-scene predictions then independent same-seed analyses
